svg.title: TheChat Backend Sequence Diagram
svg.desc: Sequence diagram for TheChat backend authentication, WebSocket subscription, message creation, Redis realtime bus fan-out, and disconnect presence update.
svg.text: Auth, WebSocket presence, chat subscription, message creation, Redis fan-out, and disconnect flow.
buildApp registers config, cors, errors, db, redis, auth, websocket, docs, then domain modules.
HTTP routes stay thin: route -> handler -> service -> repository -> PostgreSQL.
Chats and presence bind realtime adapters used by the WebSocket plugin.
Realtime delivery goes through Redis Pub/Sub, validates event shape, then sends to indexed subscribed sockets.

g.text: insert if sender is chat member
load message DTO + member user ids
update lastSeenAt when no connections remain
